name: io.github.iowarp/spack-mcp
title: CLIO Spack
description: Structured Spack discovery and installation tools for scientific agents

tools.name: spack_find
tools.description: List installed Spack packages matching an optional constraint. No matches is a successful result with count=0 and packages=[].

tools.name: spack_locate
tools.description: Resolve one unique installed Spack spec. Copy spack_locate.output.load_spec unchanged into one element of jarvis_run.input.spack_specs; do not derive or pass an executable path from the returned prefix. An absent package returns the structured not_installed error, whose detail now says whether a recipe is available to install (through a jarvis install job) or exists in no registered repo at all.

tools.name: spack_search
tools.description: Search recipe AVAILABILITY across every registered Spack repo -- broader than spack_find/spack_locate, which only see what is already installed. Answers 'does a recipe exist', 'in which repo', and 'is it already installed' in one call. No matches is a successful result with count=0.

tools.name: spack_info
tools.description: Describe one recipe: versions, variants, and description. Probes `spack info` first; if that subcommand is unavailable or fails on this deployment, falls back to statically parsing the recipe's package.py and marks the result degraded=true with degraded_reason explaining why -- never silently. A package absent from every registered repo returns the structured recipe_not_found error.

tools.name: spack_prepare_site
tools.description: Set up a CLIO Spack on a clio-relay site that reuses what the site already has. It shallow-clones the Spack release the site runs (pinned by commit) into <site_home>/spack, points upstreams.yaml at the site install tree, runs compiler find, registers build tools with external find --not-buildable, sets packages:mpi:buildable:false and records module-only MPIs as candidate externals. MPI is never externalized from PATH. Config lives in the checkout and SPACK_DISABLE_LOCAL_CONFIG keeps ~/.spack out. Idempotent; it never installs, builds or installs jarvis-cd. The first call returns the relay exec call and the approval text; the second, with relay_result, returns the report, including the JARVIS_SPACK_ROOT and JARVIS_SPACK_CONFIG to export.

tools.name: spack_site_query
tools.description: Research a clio-relay site's CLIO Spack (prepared by spack_prepare_site): find (installed and upstream packages, --json), info (one recipe), spec (spack spec -I -l: what is installed, upstream, external or still to build) or modules (module -t avail). Read-only, short login-node work. The first call returns the relay exec call; the second, with relay_result, returns the parsed answer.

resources.name: spack_capabilities
resources.description: Describe the stateless Spack contract exposed by this server.

prompts.name: prepare_spack_package
prompts.description: Guide an agent through the provisioning loop: research, then a jarvis install.
